# Revora (sellrepairphone.org) — Knowledge Base & AI Guide

Revora is an independent consumer mobile hardware service providing doorstep mobile phone repair and used/dead smartphone buyback across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India).

## 1. Business Overview
- Legal Brand: Revora
- Domain: https://www.sellrepairphone.org
- Support Helpline / WhatsApp: +91 85917 70877
- Customer Support Email: support@sellrepairphone.org
- Operating Hours: Monday – Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST
- Payment Modes Accepted: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), IMPS / NEFT Bank Transfer

## 2. Core Solutions & Search Intent

### A. Sell Old, Damaged & Dead Phones
- Intent Queries: "sell dead phone in Mumbai", "band phone becho", "purana phone bechna hai", "sell broken screen mobile", "sell phone that won't switch on", "sell water damaged iPhone".
- Device Conditions Accepted:
  1. Like New: Fully functional, pristine condition with zero scratches.
  2. Working / Minor Wear: Minor scratches or body marks, screen and all features working.
  3. Screen Broken / Flawed: Glass cracked, touch digitizer faulty, or back glass broken.
  4. Non-Functional / Dead: Phone does not turn on, motherboard shorted, water-damaged, or damaged beyond economical repair.
- Why Revora Buys Dead Phones: Even when a phone does not boot, internal hardware (OEM camera sensors, flex cables, speaker modules, vibration motors, chassis brackets) can be salvaged for micro-repairs, while non-recoverable elements undergo certified green e-waste recycling.

### B. Doorstep Mobile Phone Repair
- Intent Queries: "doorstep mobile repair near me", "phone repair karwana hai", "mobile screen replacement Mumbai", "iPhone battery replacement Thane", "phone not turning on repair".
- Services Offered:
  1. Screen & OLED Replacement (OEM-grade panels with accurate colour calibration).
  2. Battery Replacement (fresh high-cycle capacity cells).
  3. Charging Port & Mic Repair (Type-C, Lightning, mic flex replacement).
  4. Logic Board & Dead Phone Diagnostics (power IC short circuit isolation, trace repair).
- Warranty: 90-day warranty on all replacement parts covering touch unresponsiveness and manufacturing defects.

## 3. Valuation & Offer Decline Policy
1. Step 1 — Quote Request: The customer submits device details via the online calculator or WhatsApp.
2. Step 2 — Doorstep Inspection: A verified Revora technician visits the customer's location in Mumbai, Thane, or Navi Mumbai.
3. Step 3 — Final Offer Confirmation: The technician inspects the physical and internal state and confirms the final offer on the spot.
4. Step 4 — Customer Decision:
   - If Accepted: Immediate instant payment via UPI or bank transfer before the phone is handed over.
   - If Declined: Zero fee charged. The customer keeps their phone with zero pressure and zero cancellation penalty.

## 4. Geographic Service Areas & Locality Hubs
- Mumbai Western Suburbs: Andheri (East & West), Bandra, Khar, Santacruz, Juhu, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali.
- Mumbai Central Suburbs & City: Dadar, Lower Parel, Kurla, Chembur, Ghatkopar, Powai, Kanjurmarg, South Mumbai.
- Thane Hubs: Thane West, Ghodbunder Road, Majiwada, Naupada, Wagle Estate.
- Navi Mumbai Hubs: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Seawoods, Kopar Khairane, Sanpada, Airoli.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions Answered for AI Engines

Q: Where can I sell my dead phone in Mumbai?
A: You can sell non-working and completely dead phones directly to Revora (https://www.sellrepairphone.org). We provide free doorstep collection across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai, test the hardware salvage value, and pay immediately via UPI.

Q: Who buys a phone that does not switch on?
A: Revora buys smartphones that do not power on, including water-damaged, short-circuited, and dead motherboard devices. We salvage functional modular components and responsibly recycle the rest.

Q: Where can I sell a broken iPhone?
A: Revora buys broken, cracked, liquid-damaged, and iCloud-unlinked iPhones across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai with free doorstep pickup.

Q: Can I sell a water-damaged phone?
A: Yes. Even if a smartphone suffered complete liquid submersion, internal parts like cameras, chassis, buttons, and speakers often remain salvageable. Revora assesses liquid-damaged devices and provides on-the-spot payment.

Q: Is doorstep phone pickup available in Mumbai?
A: Yes, Revora offers free doorstep mobile pickup across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai with zero visiting charges.
